observation: Every installed agent-loop skill and the SessionStart discipline payload spell the CLI as 'vendor/bin/agent-loop'. In this repository that path does not exist, because the workflow CLI lives in the isolated tool project under tools/agent-loop. 'make/agent-loop.mk' already solves the same problem for Make targets with an overridable AGENT_LOOP_BIN variable, but nothing renders that value into the projected skill text.

evidence.summary: The projected skills repeat the hard-coded path many times; the repository added bin/agent-loop as a wrapper so the documented command exists at all.

hypothesis: Guidance that names an executable path is configuration, not prose, and has to be rendered per host like the Make targets already are.
validated_conclusion: The skill projection should substitute the host's configured entrypoint (the AGENT_LOOP_BIN value or an init.json key) when it writes the client skill files, so an agent reading a projected skill never gets a command that this repository cannot run.

validation_case.given: a host repository runs the workflow CLI from a path other than vendor/bin/agent-loop
validation_case.when: the skills are projected into a client
validation_case.then: the projected commands name the entrypoint that exists in that repository
